articles.company_name: Net Lease Office Properties Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
articles.summary: Net Lease Office Properties (NYSE: NLOP) reported today that its Board of Trustees declared a special cash distribution of $4.10 per common share, totaling approximately $60.7 million. The distribution is payable on December 19, 2025 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on December 4, 2025. The following property was recently sold for gross proceeds of approximately $33.0 million. Tenant Tenant Industry Location ABR (at time of sale) ($000s) Gross Sale Proceeds ($000s) Square F
